bookSourceComment:
69书吧·繁中(pv站 https://69shuba.tw)。
【重要】本站自研人机验证(ALTCHA PoW)+Cloudflare：非浏览器客户端(含阅读原生网络)会被403验证页拦截，本源已在链路上自动改用内置浏览内核过盾取页，首次访问/验证过期时会略慢(每次页面约1~2秒)，属正常现象。
若提示人机验证未通过：书源『登录』→ 点『🛡网页过盾』；仍失败请用系统浏览器访问一次 69shuba.tw 后重试。
规则：搜索 GET /search/?searchkey=；详情 /book/{id}/；目录 /indexlist/{id}/ 每页100章；正文 /read/{bid}/{cid} 单页。
兼容性：列表条目以 JSON 字符串返回,同步兼容 LegadoTeam 与 legado-E(Luoyacheng)。
注意：站点风控较严，请勿高频访问；阅读预下载章节数建议保持默认(偏少为佳)。
header: {"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14; Pixel 8) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36"}
loginUi: [{"type": "button", "name": "ck", "viewName": "✅ 检查访问状态", "action": "checkStatus()"}, {"type": "button", "name": "dv", "viewName": "🛡 网页过盾", "action": "passAegis()"}, {"type": "button", "name": "ob", "viewName": "🌐 打开网站", "action": "openSite()"}]
loginCheckJs: (function(){var r=result;var b='';try{b=String(r.body());}catch(e){}var hit=b.indexOf('altcha-widget')>-1||b.indexOf('aegis_altcha')>-1;if(!hit){return r;}var u=String(r.url());var src=null;try{src=java.webView(null,u,null);}catch(e){}if(src!=null&&String(src).length>800&&String(src).indexOf('altcha-widget')<0){return new Packages.io.legado.app.help.http.StrResponse(u,String(src));}throw new Error('🔒 69书吧人机验证未通过：请在书源『登录』面板点『🛡网页过盾』后重试；仍失败请改用浏览器访问一次 69shuba.tw 再试。');})()

ruleSearch.bookList: @js:(function(){var el=result;if(el==null){return [];}if(typeof el.select!=='function'){el=Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(el));}var tabs=el.select('table.list-item');var out=[];for(var t=0;t<tabs.size();t++){var tb=tabs.get(t);var a0=tb.selectFirst('div.article > a');if(a0==null){continue;}var name=String(a0.text()).trim();var meta=tb.selectFirst('p.fs12.gray');var au='';var wc='';if(meta!=null){var mt=String(meta.text());var m=mt.match(/作者[:：]\s*([^\s\u3000]+)/);if(m){au=m[1];}var m2=mt.match(/([0-9][0-9.]*)\s*万字/);if(m2){wc=m2[1]+'万字';}}var ints=tb.select('div.article > a');var intro='';if(ints.size()>1){intro=String(ints.get(1).text()).trim();}var url=a0.attr('href');var img=tb.selectFirst('td img');var cover='';if(img!=null){cover=String(img.attr('src'));if(cover.indexOf('//')===0){cover='https:'+cover;}}out.push(String(JSON.stringify({name:name,author:au,intro:intro,bookUrl:url,coverUrl:cover,wordCount:wc})));}return out;})()
ruleSearch.name: $.name
ruleSearch.author: $.author

ruleBookInfo.name: h1@text
ruleBookInfo.author: meta[property=og:novel:author]@content
ruleBookInfo.wordCount: @js:(function(){var el=result;if(el==null){return '';}if(typeof el.select!=='function'){el=Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(el));}var td=el.selectFirst('div.bookinfo td.info');if(td==null){return '';}var t=String(td.text());var m=t.match(/([0-9][0-9.]*)\s*万字/);return m?(m[1]+'万字'):'';})()

ruleToc.chapterList: @js:(function(){var html=String(result);var doc=Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);var out=[];var items=doc.select('ul.last9 li a');for(var i=0;i<items.size();i++){var a=items.get(i);var h=String(a.attr('href'));if(h.indexOf('/read/')===-1){continue;}var nm=String(a.text()).trim();if(nm.length===0){continue;}out.push(String(JSON.stringify({name:nm,url:h})));}return out;})()

ruleContent.content: @js:(function(){var html=String(result);var doc=Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);var nr=doc.selectFirst('div.nr_nr');if(nr==null){var need=html.indexOf('altcha-widget')>-1||html.length<4000;if(need){var u=String(baseUrl);var h2=null;try{h2=java.webView(null,u,null);}catch(e){if(String(e).length<200){}}if(h2!=null){var s2=String(h2);if(s2.indexOf('altcha-widget')<0){html=s2;doc=Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);nr=doc.selectFirst('div.nr_nr');}}}if(nr==null){return '';}}var n1=nr.selectFirst('#nr1');if(n1==null){return String(nr.text()).trim();}n1.select('.reader-ad').remove();var ps=n1.select('p');var arr=[];for(var i=0;i<ps.size();i++){var t=String(ps.get(i).text()).trim();if(t.length>0){arr.push(t);}}var out=arr.join(String.fromCharCode(10));if(out.length<20){out=String(n1.text()).trim();}return out;})()

ruleExplore.bookList: @js:(function(){var el=result;if(el==null){return [];}if(typeof el.select!=='function'){el=Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(el));}var tabs=el.select('table.list-item');var out=[];for(var t=0;t<tabs.size();t++){var tb=tabs.get(t);var a0=tb.selectFirst('div.article > a');if(a0==null){continue;}var name=String(a0.text()).trim();var meta=tb.selectFirst('p.fs12.gray');var au='';var wc='';if(meta!=null){var mt=String(meta.text());var m=mt.match(/作者[:：]\s*([^\s\u3000]+)/);if(m){au=m[1];}var m2=mt.match(/([0-9][0-9.]*)\s*万字/);if(m2){wc=m2[1]+'万字';}}var ints=tb.select('div.article > a');var intro='';if(ints.size()>1){intro=String(ints.get(1).text()).trim();}var url=a0.attr('href');var img=tb.selectFirst('td img');var cover='';if(img!=null){cover=String(img.attr('src'));if(cover.indexOf('//')===0){cover='https:'+cover;}}out.push(String(JSON.stringify({name:name,author:au,intro:intro,bookUrl:url,coverUrl:cover,wordCount:wc})));}return out;})()
ruleExplore.name: $.name
ruleExplore.author: $.author
ruleExplore.kind: @js:(function(){var r=String(baseUrl);var map={xuanhuan:'玄幻',wuxia:'仙侠',dushi:'都市',lishi:'历史',youxi:'游戏',kehu:'科幻',yanqing:'言情',tongren:'同人'};var m=r.match(/fenlei\/([a-z]+)/);if(m&&map[m[1]]){return map[m[1]];}if(r.indexOf('quanben')>-1){return '完本';}return '';})()
